<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: x-large;"><span lang="zh-CN"><b>暗渡陈仓</b></span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: x-large;"><i>Openly
Repair the Gallery Roads, but Sneak Through the Passage of Chencang</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">The
phrase comes from during the Chu-Han contention (206-202 B.C.), when
Liu Bang retreated with his army to Sichuan, wanting to prepare for a
battle with the rebel warlord Xiang Yu. Once fully prepared, Liu Bang
announced that he would rebuild the roads he had previously
destroyed, and sent some of his men to do this. All the while he was
secretly sending troops toward Guanzhong, indirectly, via the small
town of Chencang. Xiang Yu, having received news of Liu Bang
repairing the gallery roads, completely dismissed Liu Bang as a
threat, knowing it would take years to repair the roads. Liu Bang was
then able to retake Guanzhong by surprise, ultimately leading to his
victory over Xiang Yu, and the birth of the Han Dynasty [1], [19].</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, serif;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Openly
Repair the Gallery Roads but Sneak Through the Passage of </span></i></span><i>Chencang</i>,
is associated with the 42nd hexagram, <i>Wind over Thunder</i>. Wind
and thunder strengthen each other, doubling each other's energy.
Wind's outward penetrating motion provides cover for and carries
within it the Thunder which strikes unexpectedly
[1], [28].</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

<img style="display: block; margin-right: auto; margin-left: 0;" alt="" src="data:image/png;base64," /> <br /></span></span></p><p class="western" style="font-style: normal; line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: small;"></span></span></p><p class="western" style="font-style: normal; line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: small;"></span></span><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: small;">-------------------------------------</span></span></p><p class="western" style="font-style: normal; line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: small;">&nbsp;</span></span></p><p class="western" style="font-style: normal; line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: small;">

<img style="display: block; margin-right: auto; margin-left: 0;" alt="" src="data:image/png;base64," /> <br /></span></span></p><p class="western" style="font-style: normal; line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: small;">&nbsp;</span></span></p><p class="western" style="font-style: normal; line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: small;">&nbsp;</span></span>


	
	
	
	

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><b>Sample Sentences 8:</b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

</p>
<div dir="ltr" id="Section59" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我要开始锻炼身体了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: I want to start
	exercising.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">别忘记丢垃圾。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Don’t forget to
	take out the garbage.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你能不能早一点回来？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	4) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我试着做这个菜，但是失败了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">车站在哪？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	6) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;">要试着在下</span>雨之前回来。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">7</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">) </span></span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">房间里很暗。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">8</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">)</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">我们在雨雪天气中渡过了一天</span>。</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">怎么了？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">一个玻璃杯从桌子上掉下来了。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你有没有看完那本书？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	9)  Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你有没有告诉你的朋友我们在哪里见</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;面？</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">有，但是我忘记告诉他们那个GPS</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;怎么用了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">12)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我可以在地铁上看书，但是在公交车上</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;看书让我的头疼。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">13</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">)</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">那个女孩是四川人</span>。</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">14)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你可以让一个小孩完成打扫。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">15)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你准备练习的时候可以给我打电话。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">16)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">那个小孩为什么在哭？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">   
	   &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">那个小孩摔下来了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">17)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你应该选择一个饭店。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">18)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你有没有选好一个饭店？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">是的，但是我担心我们到的时候，</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;人已经很多了。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">19)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他成功地学会了怎么开车。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">20)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">今天天气不好，已经开始下雨了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">21)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在这里，一月以前不会下雪。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">22)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个是什么意思？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我不知道这个是什么意思。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">23)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你是什么意思？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">2</span></span><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">4</span></span><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">)
	</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">他不敢一个人开飞机。</span></span></p>
</div><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span style="font-size: small;"></span></span><p class="western" style="font-style: normal; line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span style="font-size: small;">&nbsp;</span></span></p><p class="western" style="font-style: normal; line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: small;">&nbsp;</span></span></p><p class="western" style="font-style: normal;
